identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a 'Mission Control' aesthetic that blends Swiss precision with Cyberpunk utility.
principles: Contrast: High-vis neon on deep matte black

theme.strategy: The 'Control Room' Protocol. Default to Dark Mode for all dashboards to reduce eye strain and increase focus. Use high-contrast neon accents for critical data.

usage_rules: Backgrounds: Always use #09090b (Zinc 950) for the main canvas.
Cards: Use #18181b (Zinc 900) with a 1px border of #27272a.
Primary Color (#ef4444): RESERVED for Emergency Actions, Critical Alerts, and 'Go' buttons.
Secondary Color (#3b82f6): Use for Navigation, Routes, and standard interactions.
Text: Never use pure white (#ffffff) for body text; use #f4f4f5.

strategies: Dispatcher Dashboard: 12-column grid. Map takes central 8 cols. Sidebars for 'Active Units' (Left) and 'Hospital Status' (Right).
Driver App: Single column, massive touch targets (min-height: 64px). Bottom sheet for route details.

components.strategy: Hybrid: Shadcn for logic, Custom Tailwind for 'HUD' look.
styling_rules: Border Radius: Small (rounded-md or rounded-sm). No pill shapes for the dashboard.
Shadows: Minimal. Use 'shadow-none' or 'shadow-sm'. Rely on borders for separation.
Glassmorphism: Use 'bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md border-white/10' for floating map overlays.

visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle noise texture to the background (opacity 0.03) to reduce digital flatness.
decorations: Scanlines: Overlay on map views for 'Tactical' feel.
Blinking Dots: Use for live status indicators (Green = Online, Red = Emergency).
visual_enhancers.icons: Lucide React (default). Use 'ShieldAlert' for emergencies, 'Activity' for status.

login_hero.alt: Ambulance with flashing lights at night
login_hero.usage: Full screen background for Login/Landing with heavy dark overlay (bg-black/80).

hospital_default.usage: Thumbnail for hospital list items or modal headers.

map_context.usage: Background for 'Traffic Analysis' section or simulation mode.

rules: Duration: Fast (150ms - 200ms). Emergency tools must feel instant.
Contrast: Ensure text on red/blue backgrounds is white/bold.
Focus Rings: High visibility (ring-2 ring-white) for keyboard navigation.
Screen Readers: All map icons must have 'aria-label'.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to index.css immediately.
2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js with the 'Zinc' color palette and 'Chivo'/'IBM Plex Sans' font families.
3. BUILD LAYOUTS: Start with the Dispatcher Dashboard using the 'Bento' grid. It is the core of the system.
4. MAP INTEGRATION: Use a placeholder 'div' with the 'map_context' image as a background if the real map API is not ready, but style the overlays (HUD) as if it were live.
5. USE SHADCN: Heavily customize the Shadcn components to match the 'Zinc 950' dark theme. Do not use the default white styles.
6. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid to every interactive element (e.g., 'emergency-toggle-btn', 'assign-ambulance-btn').
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': Do not use generic gradients or centered text layouts.
Micro-Interactions: Every button must have a hover state (brightness-110 or border color change).
Spacing: Use p-6 or p-8 for internal card padding. Don't cram text.
